summary.headline: Alembic Q1 FY27 revenue rose 26% YoY to INR2,150 crore; FY27 growth guidance raised to closer to mid-teens on US Generics.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 26% YoY to INR2,150 crore, with reported EBITDA up 21% to INR348 crore at a 16% margin. PAT rose 12% to INR173 crore, held back by a higher effective tax rate of about 22% after migrating to the new tax regime. US Generics growth was raised to mid-to-high teens for FY27 from low-to-mid teens, lifting overall company growth outlook to closer to mid-teens from low double digits. Management said the US branded business (Pivya and two smaller UTI-adjacent products) is a drag on margins in the ramp-up phase and is expected to break even around year-end.

segments.name: US Generics
segments.commentary: Grew 49% YoY in INR, driven by volume, new launches and Bosutinib (launched June, one month of sales in Q1). Ex-Bosutinib US business grew close to 25%; FY27 US guidance raised to mid-to-high teens from low-to-mid teens.

segments.name: US Branded Specialty (Pivya + 2 smaller products)
segments.commentary: Soft launch in first three months; a drag on margins. Management expects breakeven around end-FY27 and positive contribution from FY28. No manufacturing capex; cost is field force and marketing, product sourced from a CMO.

segments.name: India Branded
segments.commentary: Grew 7%. Animal Health grew 24% (about 22% of India revenue); acute is about 37% of India revenue. Specialty is about 60% of total revenue; Gynae, Gastro and Ophthal growing in line with market.

segments.name: International Generics (ex-US, ROW)
segments.commentary: Grew 37%. Management guides ROW growth of about 15% in INR for the year; new JV in Saudi Arabia and Canada, new Latin American territories.

segments.name: API
segments.commentary: Grew 33% in volume-led growth. FY27 guidance was about 10% plus/minus; management now expects to finish above the ~10% level.

guidance_outlook: Overall company FY27 growth now closer to mid-teens, up from low double digits; investment agenda unchanged.
US Generics FY27 growth raised to mid-to-high teens in INR, subject to normal market conditions.
Around 15 more US launches over the remaining nine months of FY27; similar launch count expected next year.

Core-business EBITDA margin expected to improve toward high teens, partly offset by about 150 bps full-year dilution from US branded business; management says FY27 margin broadly flat to slightly better than FY26 (16%).
India business guided to grow close to market growth, roughly high single digits, with gap to market to be bridged.
Gross margin guided at 70-75% range; Q1 was within range but diluted by solvent prices, product mix and under-absorption from Ophthalmic-line debottlenecking shutdown.
Working capital and gross debt expected to unwind in Q2 and Q3; debt to be brought back to at least March 2026 levels and aimed at about 1x EBITDA.
Ex-US business guided to grow about 15% in INR for FY27.
capex_capacity: INR400 crore capex added in the last year (per CFO); debottlenecking and capacity enhancement programmes ongoing in manufacturing.
Ophthalmic-line preventive debottlenecking completed in Q1 FY27, expanding capacity without incremental capex but causing under-absorption in the quarter.
Peptide development programme progressing; R&D at INR186 crore in Q1 for peptide development, exhibit batches and filings.

Depreciation up sharply YoY: intangible assets acquired for US branded business capitalised in Q4 FY26, amortised over 7-8 years; about 70-75% of the QoQ increase in depreciation attributed to intangibles.
demand_pricing: US pricing pressure persists, but Q1 US growth was predominantly volume-driven; management expects erosion to be offset by launches.
Bosutinib: small-volume, high-price indication; exclusivity on 100mg and 500mg strengths runs until November 2026; no incremental competitor seen yet.
Management sees US base run-rate (ex-Bosutinib) potentially holding at a higher level for the next quarter or two, but is uncertain given price erosion.
India human health: management changes under Ramesh Juneja; acute and some divisions dragging, while gastro, ophthalmic and cardio grow in double digits. Azithral and cough/cold traction improving.
Ex-US business is B2B and subject to quarter-to-quarter supply variance; management reiterated 15% INR growth for year.
Management declined to commit on FY28 US growth beyond a stated goal, citing the need to see the branded product trajectory over the next couple of months.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Q1 US growth came from Bosutinib and launches, and what is the Pivya investment and breakeven path?
qa_highlights.answer: Ex-Bosutinib US business grew about 25% on launches from Q4 and Q1 (six to seven in Q1). Pivya is a soft launch; investment is only field force and marketing; breakeven targeted around end of FY27 with positive contribution in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY27 margin guidance given the apparent confusion between flat margins and high-teens?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said core margin improves to high teens, partly offset by about 150 bps dilution from US branded. CFO said FY27 margin should improve slightly versus FY26's 16%, with breakeven timing determining whether it is better or flattish.

qa_highlights.question: Is the higher US base (about $75-76m per quarter ex-Bosutinib) the new normal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management would like it to be, but must balance against price erosion and possible share loss; expects the trend to continue for at least one or two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What is the India business growth outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO guided India business close to market growth, roughly high single digits, with the gap to market expected to narrow versus last year.

qa_highlights.question: Quantify US sales in USD and constant-currency growth.
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give a USD figure; it suggested about 10% currency impact, implying roughly 37-38% constant-currency US growth.

qa_highlights.question: Why did interest cost rise and what is the debt outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross debt about INR1,600 crore, higher than March due to receivables from higher sales; lower interest rates partly offset. Debt expected to unwind in Q2-Q3, returning at least to March levels and aiming near 1x EBITDA.

financial_highlights.change: higher than March 2026 on receivables build-up

risks_watch: Bosutinib exclusivity on 100mg and 500mg runs only until November 2026; management cannot guide beyond that and sees no incremental competitor yet, so the US base may step down in Q3 FY27.
US price erosion and possible share loss may offset the higher ex-Bosutinib base; management expects the trend to hold for only one or two quarters.
US branded (Pivya and two smaller UTI products) is a soft launch with breakeven targeted around end-FY27; a slower ramp would keep the ~150 bps margin drag and weigh on FY27 margin versus FY26's 16%.
Gross margin pressure from solvent prices, product mix and Ophthalmic-line under-absorption; watch whether Q2 gross margin recovers within the 70-75% guided range.
Debt and interest cost: gross debt about INR1,600 crore, above March 2026 levels; watch for unwinding of receivables in Q2-Q3 toward March levels and about 1x EBITDA.
India human health recovery under Ramesh Juneja is a work in progress; management expects positive trends only in another quarter or two, and India is guided only to high single-digit growth.
Depreciation step-up from intangibles capitalised in Q4 FY26 (7-8 year amortisation); absolute amount not disclosed on the call and was to be followed up offline.
key_quotes: Q1 FY27 has been a strong start to the year with broad-based growth across all the businesses and continued execution on the strategic priorities that we outlined at the beginning of the year.
we now expect the US business to grow mid to high teens in the year, subject to normal market conditions and continued execution.
But at least for the next quarter or 2, I see that this trend should continue.
Until November is what I know for sure. I really can't guide above beyond that.
summary.management_tone: Confident on US Generics volumes, launches and the raised FY27 US guidance, but cautious and evasive on US branded breakeven timing, FY28 US growth and post-November Bosutinib sales, where the MD repeatedly said he could not guide. Margin messaging was less crisp: the CFO first said margins would hold, then said FY27 would be slightly better than FY26 depending on breakeven timing.

adds.what: Ophthalmic-line preventive debottlenecking (capacity expansion without incremental capex)
Manufacturing debottlenecking and capacity enhancement programmes (INR400 crore capex added in last year)

growth.why: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 26% YoY to INR2,150 crore and management raised FY27 growth to closer to mid-teens (US Generics raised to mid-to-high teens), though India guided only high single digit and ROW about 15%, and the ophthalmic debottlenecking caused under-absorption.
